arc.fallback: The Wind, the Chariot, and Wamuu

description.fallback: With the Ripple flowing throughout his arms and torso, Wamuu is no longer capable of using the Divine Sandstorm. Joseph prepares to finish Wamuu with a Ripple Overdrive, but Wamuu kicks at Joseph. Joseph, predicting this desperate attack, dodges and strikes Wamuu's legs with the Overdrive, rendering Wamuu immobile.
